_doc: Wiring facts a card needs that the source data lacks; shown to the builder as the card's NOTE (v5). Data, not code. Each fact is the part's standard pinout.
led-matrix-8x8: 1088AS/788BS-style 8x8 matrix, pins numbered 1-16 counter-clockwise from the bottom-left (printed side down): rows R1-R8 are pins 9, 14, 8, 12, 1, 7, 2, 5; columns C1-C8 are pins 13, 3, 4, 10, 6, 11, 15, 16. Rows are the LED anodes, columns the cathodes. Wire a board pin to the matrix PIN the tutorial names, then find which row/column that pin is. Current-limiting resistors: one per COLUMN line (the cathodes), all 8 on the columns, never some on rows and some on columns.
midi-jack: 5-pin DIN socket, pins numbered 1-5 as printed (1 and 3 unused). MIDI out from a board: pin 4 to +5V through a 220 ohm resistor, pin 5 to the TX pin through a 220 ohm resistor, pin 2 to ground.
buzzer: Polarised piezo buzzer: pin 2 is + (goes to the signal pin, e.g. the Arduino pin), pin 1 is - (goes to GND). Do not reverse it.
rgb-led: Common-anode or common-cathode RGB LED: the long common leg is COM; R, G and B each need their own resistor.
